info.title: SEC Fundamentals API
info.description: Normalized SEC XBRL financial data for humans and agents. Pay per call with x402 (USDC) or use an API key. Not affiliated with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

get.summary: Find a company's CIK by ticker, CIK or name (free)
get.description:
Free, no API key or payment: resolve a ticker or company name to the SEC
CIK every /company/{cik} route takes. Best match first: exact ticker
(case-insensitive), exact CIK, name starts with q, name contains q; within
each, companies with tickers before other filers (individuals, funds),
then by name and CIK. Each result: cik, name, tickers, sic,
sic_description. No match is an empty result list, not a 404.

schema.description: A ticker (AAPL, BRK.B), CIK digits (320193), or all or part of a company name (apple); surrounding whitespace is ignored

resource.description: Normalized SEC EDGAR XBRL facts for one US public company: every reported value (revenue, net income, assets, cash flow, ...) mapped to 61 canonical concepts with units, periods, filing provenance and data-quality flags. Composite factor scorecard. Research signal, not investment advice.

Composite factor scorecard (0-100) for one company, fusing quality (Piotroski F-Score, Altman Z, Sloan accruals), value (owner-earnings DCF margin of safety), insider conviction (Form 4 buying), institutional positioning (13F holder change) and short sentiment (FINRA short volume), with per-factor scores, coverage, cross-dataset metrics and data-quality flags. Weights are caller-overridable. Research signal, not investment advice.
